diploLines.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🪤 A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid is back from the snares: +340 kcal to the pantry.

🪤 A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)

2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with thick glasses speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
